effort_selection_rule: Prefer high when both efforts pass every lane, high is no more than 0.05 below max on any lane, and high does not exceed max in both total elapsed time and provider-reported cost. Select max only when it passes every lane and high fails a threshold or trails max by more than 0.05 on at least one lane. Otherwise retain GLM-5.2 and publish no GLM-5.3 operational route.
decision_rule: A successful comparison can qualify clerk and scout explicit-only and can promote builder only to provisional at the selected exact tuple. Failure, VOID, or an inconclusive effort choice leaves GLM-5.2 unchanged. No result qualifies reviewer, judgement, security, policy annotation, another model, backend, effort, or harness.
